headline: Discussed the $5,000 grant maximum and who can apply; agreed to review the decision rubric at a future meeting.
summary: Reviewed the 2025 grant application and recipient reporting and discussed updates for the 2026 process. Discussed whether to change the $5,000 maximum grant amount and whether to revise who can apply. Agreed to review the decision rubric at a future meeting.
decisions: Agreed to review the decision rubric at a future meeting.
